facts.fact: NCRA Director General Massaquoi said on 10 August 2026 that NCRA has established an identity verification platform in use.
The same NCRA identity verification platform is used by institutions including financial and telecommunications companies, per the Director General.
NCRA Director General Massaquoi said NCRA has integrated civil registration with identity management, one body holding both functions.

SLE.note: No count or share of people enrolled in the ID system; only 2019 DHS birth registration figures, which are not all births.
A birth-to-death continuous identity system is called for as a next stage; no number given at birth is stated.
Who operates or maintains the system is not stated.

facts.fact: The Electoral Commission said on 10 August 2026 that linking its voter registration with the NCRA identity system would help verify eligible voters and reduce duplication ahead of the 2028 elections.

NCRA Director General Massaquoi said NCRA has strengthened the national identity infrastructure and issued secure identity documents, and the Bank of Sierra Leone referred to the unique National Identification Number.
